brief: Can you order me the BaristaPro espresso machine? It's a surprise gift for my husband. I need it here by this Wednesday the 8th so I've got time to wrap it for his birthday on Thursday. But he works from home all week — the only time he's out is Friday the 10th for his conference, so make sure it doesn't actually arrive until then, or he'll see it come to the door and the surprise is ruined. Email me at alice@shopgym.com to confirm. Thanks!

detected_traps: Contradictory delivery-window constraint: user wants package by Wednesday 8th but must NOT arrive until Friday 10th — logically infeasible for a single order
No standard ecommerce affordance exists to specify 'hold delivery until date X' — only ship-to address and standard shipping speeds are controllable
False premise: user assumes the system can route/delay a single order to arrive on a specific future date while keeping it out of sight until Friday
